channel.title: Platform Engineering Radar
channel.description: Internal engineering radar for reliability and delivery work.

item.title: Cache stampede drill validates checkout safeguards
item.description: Load tests confirmed lock coalescing during catalog invalidation.
item.content:encoded: The platform team ran a controlled cache stampede drill and confirmed checkout latency stayed within the agreed budget.

item.title: Incident runbooks add owner handoff checkpoints
item.description: Every sev-two runbook now names a handoff reviewer.
item.content:encoded: Runbook updates include owner handoff checkpoints, customer update templates, and post-incident review timing.

item.title: Deploy freeze calendar published for launch week
item.description: Launch week changes require platform approval after Wednesday.
item.content:encoded: The release calendar lists service owners, freeze windows, and rollback coordinators for launch week.

item.title: Queue depth alerts separate ingestion from billing
item.description: Separate alert rules reduce noisy pages during billing exports.
item.content:encoded: New queue depth alerts split ingestion lag from billing export backlog, making dashboards easier to triage.

item.title: TLS rotation dry run completes ahead of partner deadline
item.description: Partner endpoints accepted the new intermediate certificate chain.
item.content:encoded: The dry run verified partner callbacks, mobile clients, and webhook signature validation.
